scoring_rules: Exact K-number or GTIN printed on the label equals the record: 100 points.
Manufacturer: up to 40 points, in proportion to the label's maker words found in the record's applicant / owner. A maker match needs all of them.
Model number found in the record's device name or model field: 25 points.
Device name: up to 25 points, in proportion to the label's name words found in the record.
A record is kept only if it has an exact id, a maker match, a model match, or at least 50% of the label's name words.
Order: exact id first, then maker match, then score, then newest decision date, then id.
At most 3 are shown. None is chosen for the person.
disclaimer: Possible matches for a person to confirm. This is a search of public openFDA records, not an identification of the device, and not medical advice.
